Protocol 1000 Plus - Internal DMSO Protocol

Protocol mms miracle-mineral-solution sodium-chlorite citric-acid activated dmso

Evidence: Grade C (traditional_use)

Summary

Protocol 1000 Plus requires addition of DMSO to hourly MMS1 Protocol 1000 dosing. Add 3 drops DMSO per drop of MMS1 to the hourly dose.

Indications

  • internal-dosing
  • dmso-enhanced
  • enhanced-protocol

Contraindications

  • dmso-allergy
  • pregnancy
  • kidney-disease
  • severe-heart-conditions
  • bleeding-disorders

Dosage

Add 3 drops DMSO per 1 drop of MMS1 to hourly Protocol 1000 dose (e.g., 3 drops MMS1 + 9 drops DMSO per hour)

Frequency: 1-3 drops MMS1 per hour with corresponding DMSO, for up to 8 hours daily
